profile.headline: Computer Science Student | Web Director | Incoming SWE at J.P. Morgan Chase
profile.summary:
👋 I’m a dedicated computer science student at The University of Texas at Austin with experience in software development, systems programming, and teaching. 

I’m passionate about solving complex problems and building efficient, scalable software solutions. My experience spans across full-stack web development, low-level systems programming, and leading technical projects.

positions.title: Full-stack Developer
positions.description:
- Managed the migration of the KVRX website to WordPress using HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and SQL, leading cross-functional teams to ensure data integrity, performance optimization, and compatibility resolution.
- Developed a Python script using Pandas and NumPy to migrate PostgreSQL-formatted data into SQL and provide flexible export options in formats like CSV and XML.
- Led a team of 11 interns in enhancing website functionality, utilizing Git for version control, Docker for containerized environments, and improving documentation.
- Directed the development of a new user interface in collaboration with the graphics team, ensuring a cohesive, user-friendly design with React and TeX.
positions.insights: Skills: Project Management · Python (Programming Language) · React.js · JavaScript · PHP · Node.js · Django · PostgreSQL · Software Construction · Amazon Web Services (AWS) · HTML · WordPress · Front-End Development · SQL · Git · Pandas (Software)

positions.title: Teaching Assistant for CS 303E
positions.description:
- Facilitated online discussions and office hours to assist students in mastering programming concepts and problem-solving techniques.
- Graded programming projects, providing detailed feedback to improve code quality and adherence to best practices.
- Supported students with software engineering principles and development methodologies through personalized assistance during office hours and online interactions.

projects.title: Data Migration and Conversion
projects.description: Used Python libraries to create a script that accessed and imported data from a AWS RDS Postgre-SQL formatted database. Converted that data in a SQL format. Used the formatted data in XML, and CSV files that were read and imported into WordPress
